sn35.84:1.2: Then the Venerable Ānanda approached the Blessed One … and said to him: “Venerable sir, it is said,
sn35.84:2.1: ‘the world, the world.’ In what way, venerable sir, is it said
sn35.84:2.3: “Whatever is subject to disintegration, Ānanda, is called the world in the Noble One’s Discipline.
sn35.84:2.4: And what is subject to disintegration?
sn35.84:2.5: The eye, Ānanda, is subject to disintegration, forms … eye-consciousness … eye-contact … whatever feeling arises with eye-contact as condition … that too is subject to disintegration.
sn35.84:2.6: The ear is subject to disintegration …
sn35.84:2.7: The mind is subject to disintegration … Whatever feeling arises with mind-contact as condition … that too is subject to disintegration.
sn35.84:2.8: Whatever is subject to disintegration, Ānanda, is called the world in the Noble One’s Discipline.”
